patterns: APPSC asks direct recall: hydro plant energy transformation = potential to electrical (APPSC 2023); Polavaram installed capacity 960 MW (APPSC 2019); dam heights in order (Tehri > Bhakra > Idukki).
Other PSCs recur on movement-leader pairs (Chipko/Gaura Devi/Chandi Prasad Bhatt, Appiko/Karnataka, NBA/Medha Patkar, Rally for the Valley = resettlement).
Device energy-conversion one-liners (dynamo, motor, battery, solar cell) are the most common shape.
App MCQs add many 2026 policy/number items (SHP outlay, CEA storage split, ISTS waiver) and thermal-plant data well beyond PYQ depth; AP project capacities are the right emphasis.
